name: Asahi (Yamagata, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Asahi town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised triangular device.
history: Municipal flag of Asahi, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1963.

features.role: Asahi town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised triangular device
